Your Machine Learning (ML) team requires access to NVIDIA L4 GPUs in order to train their models. You want to accomplish this while minimizing both effort and cost. What should you do?

options.A: Ask your ML team to add the "accelerator: gpu" annotation to their pod specification.
options.B: Recreate all the nodes of the GKE cluster to enable GPUs on all of them.
options.C: Create your own Kubernetes cluster on top of Compute Engine with nodes that have GPUs. Dedicate this cluster to your ML team.
options.D: Add a new, GPU-enabled, node pool to the GKE cluster. Ask your ML team to add the cloud.google.com/gke-accelerator: nvidia-l4 nodeSelector to their pod specification.

questions.question: You need a dynamic way of provisioning VMs on Compute Engine. The exact specifications will be in a dedicated configuration file. You want to follow Google's recommended practices. Which method should you use?

options.A: Deployment Manager
options.B: Cloud Composer
options.C: Managed Instance Group
options.D: Unmanaged Instance Group

questions.question: Your company has multiple projects linked to a single billing account in Google Cloud. You need to visualize the costs with specific metrics that should be dynamically calculated based on company-specific criteria. You want to automate the process. What should you do?

options.A: In the Google Cloud console, visualize the costs related to the projects in the Reports section.
options.B: In the Google Cloud console, visualize the costs related to the projects in the Cost breakdown section.
options.C: In the Google Cloud console, use the export functionality of the Cost table. Create a Data Studio dashboard on top of the CSV export.
options.D: Configure Cloud Billing data export to BigQuery for the billing account. Create a Data Studio dashboard on top of the BigQuery export.

questions.question: You need to enable traffic between multiple groups of Compute Engine instances that currently run in two different Google Cloud projects. Each group of Compute Engine instances is running in its own VPC. What should you do?

options.A: Verify that both projects are in a Google Cloud organization. Create a new VPC and add all instances.
options.B: Verify that both projects are in a Google Cloud organization. Share the VPC from one project and request that the Compute Engine instances in the other project use this shared VPC.
options.C: Verify that you are the Project Administrator of both projects. Create two new VPCs and add all instances.
options.D: Verify that you are the Project Administrator of both projects. Create a new VPC and add all instances.

questions.question: You are a Google Cloud organization administrator. You need to configure organization policies and log sinks on Google Cloud projects that cannot be removed by project users to comply with your company's security policies. The security policies are different for each company department. Each company department has a user with the Project Owner role assigned to their projects. What should you do?

options.A: Use a standard naming convention for projects that includes the department name. Configure organization policies on the organization and log sinks on the projects.
options.B: Use a standard naming convention for projects that includes the department name. Configure both organization policies and log sinks on the projects.
options.C: Organize projects under folders for each department. Configure both organization policies and log sinks on the folders.
options.D: Organize projects under folders for each department. Configure organization policies on the organization and log sinks on the folders.

questions.question:
You are deploying a large, multi-tiered application with more than 1,000 IP addresses in a Google Cloud project that needs to be securely isolated. The application includes the:  
  
1. web tier with frontend servers for public traffic,  
2. application tier with servers running core application logic that only need access from the web tier, and  
3. database tier with database servers that only need access from the application tier.  
  
You want to minimize cost, complexity, and administrative overhead in the network architecture. What should you do?

options.A: Create a /24 Shared VPC with separate subnets for each tier. Use firewall rules that reference network tags to control traffic.
options.B: Create one custom mode /16 VPC with three subnets. Place each tier in its own subnet and use firewall rules that reference IP subnets to control traffic.
options.C: Deploy each tier into a separate custom mode /16 VPC. Use VPC Network Peering to securely connect each custom mode VPC. Manage firewall rules individually in each VPC.
options.D: Deploy each tier in a /24 VPC by using network tags to identify instances. Implement firewall rules for fine-grained network segmentation.

questions.question: Your organization needs to grant users access so they can query datasets in BigQuery, but you want to prevent them from accidentally deleting the datasets. You want a solution that follows Google-recommended practices. What should you do?

options.A: Add users to roles/bigquery.user role only, instead of roles/bigquery.dataOwner.
options.B: Add users to roles/bigquery.dataEditor role only, instead of roles/bigquery.dataOwner.
options.C: Create a custom role by removing delete permissions, and add users to that role only.
options.D: Create a custom role by removing delete permissions. Add the users to a Google group, and grant the custom role to the group.

questions.question:
You recently discovered that your developers are using many service account keys during their development process. While you work on a long term improvement, you need to quickly implement a process to enforce short-lived service account credentials in your company. You have the following requirements:  
  
• All service accounts that require a key should be created in a centralized project called pj-sa.  

• Service account keys should only be valid for one day.  
  
You need a Google-recommended solution that minimizes cost. What should you do?

options.A: Implement a Cloud Run job to rotate all service account keys periodically in pj-sa. Enforce an org policy to deny service account key creation with an exception to pj-sa.
options.B: Implement a Kubernetes CronJob to rotate all service account keys periodically. Disable attachment of service accounts to resources in all projects with an exception to pj-sa.
options.C: Enforce an org policy constraint allowing the lifetime of service account keys to be 24 hours. Enforce an org policy constraint denying service account key creation with an exception on pj-sa.
options.D: Enforce a DENY org policy constraint over the lifetime of service account keys for 24 hours. Disable attachment of service accounts to resources in all projects with an exception to pj-sa.

questions.question: You have taken over maintenance of a Google Cloud project from a colleague. As part of a security review, you need to check who has been granted the Project Owner role. What should you do?

options.A: In the console, validate which SSH keys have been stored as project-wide keys.
options.B: Navigate to Identity-Aware Proxy and check the permissions for these resources.
options.C: Enable Audit Logs on the IAM & admin page for all resources, and validate the results.
options.D: Use the command gcloud projects get-iam-policy to view the current role assignments.

questions.question: You need to check the IAM users and roles that have been assigned within a Google Cloud project called my-project. What should you do?

options.A: Run gcloud iam roles list. Review the output section.
options.B: Run gcloud iam service-accounts list. Review the output section.
options.C: Navigate to the project and then to the IAM section in the Google Cloud console. Review the principals and roles.
options.D: Navigate to the project and then to the Roles section in the Google Cloud console. Review the roles and status.

questions.question: You are deploying an application to Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). The application needs to make API calls to a private Cloud Storage bucket. You need to configure your application Pods to authenticate to the Cloud Storage API, but your organization policy prevents the usage of service account keys. You want to follow Google-recommended practices. What should you do?

options.A: Create the GKE cluster with Workload Identity Federation. Configure the default node service account to access the bucket. Deploy the application into the cluster so the application can use the node service account permissions. Use Identity and Access Management (IAM) to grant the service account access to the bucket.
options.B: Create the GKE cluster with Workload Identity Federation. Create a Google service account and a Kubernetes ServiceAccount, and configure both service accounts to use Workload Identity Federation. Attach the Kubernetes ServiceAccount to the application Pods and configure the Google service account to access the bucket with Identity and Access Management (IAM).
options.C: Create the GKE cluster and deploy the application. Request a security exception to create a Google service account key. Set the constraints/iam.serviceAccountKeyExpiryHours organization policy to 24 hours.
options.D: Create the GKE cluster and deploy the application. Request a security exception to create a Google service account key. Set the constraints/iam.serviceAccountKeyExpiryHours organization policy to 8 hours.

questions.question: You have created several resources across multiple Google Cloud projects, and each project is linked to a different billing account. You want to build a single visual representation of all the costs incurred so you can better estimate future charges, and you want new cost data to be reflected as quickly as possible. What should you do?

options.A: Configure Cloud Billing export to BigQuery and visualize the data in Data Studio.
options.B: Visit the Cost Table page to get a CSV export and visualize it using Data Studio.
options.C: Fill all resources in the Pricing Calculator to get an estimate of the monthly cost.
options.D: Use the Cloud Billing Reports page in the Google Cloud console to view the desired cost information.

questions.question: Your company is moving its continuous integration and delivery (CI/CD) pipeline to Compute Engine instances. The pipeline will manage the entire cloud infrastructure through code. How can you ensure that the pipeline has appropriate permissions while your system is following security best practices?

options.A: • Attach a single service account to the compute instances.• Add minimal rights to the service account.• Allow the service account to impersonate a Cloud Identity user with elevated permissions to create, update, or delete resources.
options.B: • Add a step for human approval to the CI/CD pipeline before the execution of the infrastructure provisioning.• Use the human approvals IAM account for the provisioning.
options.C: • Attach a single service account to the compute instances.• Add all required Identity and Access Management (IAM) permissions to this service account to create, update, or delete resources.
options.D: • Create multiple service accounts, one for each pipeline with the appropriate minimal Identity and Access Management (IAM) permissions.• Use a secret manager service to store the key files of the service accounts.• Allow the CI/CD pipeline to request the appropriate secrets during the execution of the pipeline.

questions.question: Your web application has been running successfully on Cloud Run. You want to evaluate an updated version of the application with a specific percentage of your production users (canary deployment). What should you do?

options.A: Create a new service with the new version of the application. Split traffic between this version and the version that is currently running.
options.B: Create a new revision with the new version of the application. Split traffic between this version and the version that is currently running.
options.C: Create a new service with the new version of the application. Add an Application Load Balancer in front of both services.
options.D: Create a new revision with the new version of the application. Add an Application Load Balancer in front of both revisions.

questions.question: You administer IAM policies for your organization’s Google Cloud project. A new operations team requires the ability to start, stop, and reset existing Compute Engine VM instances in this project for basic troubleshooting. Because of strict security requirements, the operations team must not be able to delete any instances or change networking or configuration settings. You need to give team members only the minimum required permissions. What should you do?

options.A: Grant the operations team the roles/writer IAM role, and add the resource.type =='compute.googleapis.com/Instance' condition to the role.
options.B: Grant the operations team the predefined roles/compute.instanceAdmin.v1 IAM role on the project. Apply an IAM condition to exclude the compute.instances.delete permission.
options.C: Create a custom IAM role that includes only the compute.instances.start, compute.instances.stop, and compute.instances.reset permissions. Assign this role to the operations team on the project.
options.D: Grant the operations team the predefined roles/compute.viewer IAM role to allow them to view the instances. Instruct them to use the Google Cloud Console’s basic actions such as starting, stopping, and resetting.

questions.question: Your organization is migrating to Google Cloud. You want only users with company-issued Google accounts to access your Google Cloud environment. You must ensure that users of the same department can only access resources within their own department. You want to minimize operational costs while following Google-recommended practices. What should you do?

options.A: Assign users to the relevant Google Groups, and provide access to cloud resources through Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles. Periodically identify and remove non-company issued Google accounts.
options.B: Assign users to the relevant Google Groups, and provide access to cloud resources through Identity and Access Management (IAM) roles. Use organization policies to block non-company issued emails.
options.C: Create a folder for each department in Resource Manager. Grant the users of each department the Folder Admin role on the folder of their department.
options.D: Create a folder for each department in Resource Manager. Grant all company users the Folder Admin role on the organization level.

questions.question: Your team is building a website that handles votes from a large user population. The incoming votes will arrive at various rates. You want to optimize the storage and processing of the votes. What should you do?

options.A: Save the incoming votes to Firestore. Use Cloud Scheduler to trigger a Cloud Run function to periodically process the votes.
options.B: Use a dedicated instance to process the incoming votes. Send the votes directly to this instance.
options.C: Save the incoming votes to a JSON file on Cloud Storage. Process the votes in a batch at the end of the day.
options.D: Save the incoming votes to Pub/Sub. Use the Pub/Sub topic to trigger a Cloud Run function to process the votes.

questions.question: Your team is responsible for managing your organization's infrastructure, and the existing infrastructure needs to be updated. You need to communicate your proposed changes to the rest of the team, following Google's recommended best practices. What should you do?

options.A: Use Deployment Manager templates to describe the proposed changes and store them in a Cloud Storage bucket.
options.B: Use Deployment Manager templates to describe the proposed changes and store them in Cloud Source Repositories.
options.C: Apply the changes in a development environment, run gcloud compute instances list, and then save the output in a shared Storage bucket.
options.D: Apply the changes in a development environment, run gcloud compute instances list, and then save the output in Cloud Source Repositories.

questions.question: You have a VM instance running in a VPC with single-stack subnets. You need to ensure that the VM instance has a fixed IP address so that other services hosted in the same VPC can communicate with the VM. You want to follow Google-recommended practices while minimizing cost. What should you do?

options.A: Promote the existing IP address of the VM to become a static external IP address.
options.B: Promote the existing IP address of the VM to become a static internal IP address.
options.C: Reserve a new static external IPv6 address and assign the new IP address to the VM.
options.D: Reserve a new static external IP address and assign the new IP address to the VM.

questions.question: You are managing a fleet of Compute Engine Linux instances in a Google Cloud project. Your company's engineering team requires SSH access to all instances to perform routine maintenance tasks. You need to manage the SSH access for the engineering team, and you want to minimize operational overhead when engineers join or leave the team. What should you do?

options.A: Create a single SSH key pair to be shared by all engineering team members. Add the public SSH key to project metadata.
options.B: Create an SSH key pair for each engineer on the team, and add the public SSH key to the metadata of the relevant instances.
options.C: Create a Google Group for all engineering team members, and grant them the Compute Viewer IAM role. Manage group membership when engineers join or leave the team.
options.D: Create a Google Group for all engineering team members, and set up OS Login for this group on the project. Manage group membership when engineers join or leave the team.

questions.question: You want to deploy an application on Cloud Run that processes messages from a Pub/Sub topic. You want to follow Google-recommended practices. What should you do?

options.A: 1. Create a Cloud Run function that uses a Pub/Sub trigger on that topic. 2. Call your application on Cloud Run from the Cloud Run function for every message.
options.B: 1. Grant the Pub/Sub Subscriber role to the service account used by Cloud Run. 2. Create a Pub/Sub subscription for that topic. 3. Make your application pull messages from that subscription.
options.C: 1. Create a service account. 2. Give the Cloud Run Invoker role to that service account for your Cloud Run application. 3. Create a Pub/Sub subscription that uses that service account and uses your Cloud Run application as the push endpoint.
options.D: 1. Deploy your application on Cloud Run on GKE with the connectivity set to Internal. 2. Create a Pub/Sub subscription for that topic. 3. In the same Google Kubernetes Engine cluster as your application, deploy a container that takes the messages and sends them to your application.

questions.question:
You work for a financial services company that operates as a stock market broker. Your company is planning to migrate to Google Cloud. You need to plan the network design in Google Cloud. Your design must:  

• Minimize network latency for all internet-facing production systems.  

• Minimize costs related to your development environment.  
  
What should you do?

options.A: Use the Standard Tier for production resources and the Premium Tier for development resources (for example, as each project's default network tier).
options.B: Use the Premium Tier for production resources and the Standard Tier for development resources (for example, as each project's default network tier).
options.C: Use the Premium Tier for both production and development resources.
options.D: Use the Standard Tier for both production and development resources.

questions.question: You are deploying an application to Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) that needs to call an external third-party API. You need to provide the external API vendor with a list of IP addresses for their firewall to allow traffic from your application. You want to follow Google-recommended practices and avoid any risk of interrupting traffic to the API due to IP address changes. What should you do?

options.A: Configure your GKE cluster with one node, and set the node to have a static external IP address. Ensure that the GKE cluster autoscaler is off. Send the external IP address of the node to the vendor to be added to the allowlist.
options.B: Configure your GKE cluster with private nodes. Configure a Cloud NAT gateway with static IP addresses. Provide these IP addresses to the vendor to be added to the allowlist.
options.C: Configure your GKE cluster with private nodes. Configure a Cloud NAT gateway with dynamic IP addresses. Provide these IP addresses to the vendor to be added to the allowlist.
options.D: Configure your GKE cluster with public nodes. Write a Cloud Run function that pulls the public IP addresses of each node in the cluster. Trigger the function to run every day with Cloud Scheduler. Send the list to the vendor by email every day.

questions.question: After deploying an App Engine application with `gcloud app deploy`, you discover it was deployed to the wrong project. You need to determine why this occurred and identify which project the application was actually deployed to. What should you do?

options.A: Check the app.yaml file for your application and check project settings.
options.B: Check the web-application.xml file for your application and check project settings.
options.C: Go to Deployment Manager and review settings for deployment of applications.
options.D: Go to Cloud Shell and run gcloud config list to review the Google Cloud configuration used for deployment.

questions.question: Your company wants to standardize the creation and management of multiple Google Cloud resources using Infrastructure as Code. You want to minimize the amount of repetitive code needed to manage the environment. What should you do?

options.A: Develop templates for the environment using Cloud Deployment Manager.
options.B: Use curl in a terminal to send a REST request to the relevant Google API for each individual resource.
options.C: Use the Cloud Console interface to provision and manage all related resources.
options.D: Create a bash script that contains all requirement steps as gcloud commands.

questions.question: You need to configure permissions for a group of Compute Engine instances so that they can write data into a specific Cloud Storage bucket. You want to follow Google-recommended practices. What should you do?

options.A: Create a service account with an access scope. Use the access scope 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/devstorage.write_only'.
options.B: Create a service account with an access scope. Use the access scope 'https://www.googleapis.com/auth/cloud-platform'.
options.C: Create a service account and add it to the IAM role 'storage.objectCreator' for that bucket.
options.D: Create a service account and add it to the IAM role 'storage.objectAdmin' for that bucket.

questions.question: You have just created a new project which will be used to deploy a globally distributed application. You will use Spanner for data storage. You want to create a Spanner instance. You want to perform the first step in preparation of creating the instance. What should you do?

options.A: Enable the Cloud Spanner API.
options.B: Configure your Spanner instance to be multi-regional.
options.C: Create a new VPC network with subnetworks in all desired regions.
options.D: Grant yourself the IAM role of Cloud Spanner Admin.

questions.question:
You are using Container Registry to centrally store your company's container images in a separate project. In another project, you want to create a Google  

Kubernetes Engine (GKE) cluster. You want to ensure that Kubernetes can download images from Container Registry. What should you do?

options.A: In the project where the images are stored, grant the Storage Object Viewer IAM role to the service account used by the Kubernetes nodes.
options.B: When you create the GKE cluster, choose the Allow full access to all Cloud APIs option under 'Access scopes'.
options.C: Create a service account, and give it access to Cloud Storage. Create a P12 key for this service account and use it as an imagePullSecrets in Kubernetes.
options.D: Configure the ACLs on each image in Cloud Storage to give read-only access to the default Compute Engine service account.

questions.question:
Your company has a Google Cloud project that uses BigQuery for data warehousing. Your data science team changes frequently and has few members.  
  
You need to allow members of this team to perform queries, following Google-recommended practices.  
  
What should you do?

options.A: 1. Create an IAM entry for each data scientist's user account. 2. Assign the BigQuery Job User (roles/bigquery.jobUser) role to each user account.
options.B: 1. Create an IAM entry for each data scientist's user account. 2. Assign the BigQuery Data Viewer (roles/bigquery.dataViewer) role to each user account.
options.C: 1. Create a dedicated Google group in Cloud Identity. 2. Add each data scientist's user account to the group. 3. Assign the BigQuery Job User (roles/bigquery.jobUser) role to the group.
options.D: 1. Create a dedicated Google group in Cloud Identity. 2. Add each data scientist's user account to the group. 3. Assign the BigQuery Data Viewer (roles/bigquery.dataViewer) role to the group.

questions.question: You are operating several VPC-native Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) clusters that all share the same subnet. The node IP addresses available in that subnet have been used up, and you need to make sure the clusters are still able to scale up in node count when required. What should you do?

options.A: Create a new subnet in the same region as the subnet being used.
options.B: Add an alias IP range to the subnet used by the GKE clusters.
options.C: Create a new VPC, and set up VPC peering with the existing VPC.
options.D: Expand the CIDR range of the relevant subnet for the cluster.

questions.question: Your company runs a variety of applications and workloads on Google Cloud, and you are responsible for managing cloud costs. You need to identify a solution that enables you to perform detailed cost analysis. You also must be able to visualize the cost data in multiple ways on the same dashboard. What should you do?

options.A: Use the cost breakdown report with the available filters from Cloud Billing to visualize the data.
options.B: Enable the Cloud Billing export to BigQuery, and use Data Studio to visualize the data.
options.C: Run queries in Cloud Monitoring. Create dashboards to visualize the billing metrics.
options.D: Enable Cloud Monitoring metrics export to BigQuery, and use Looker to visualize the data.

questions.question:
You are the organization and billing administrator for your company. The engineering team currently holds the Project Creator role at the organization level. You want to prevent the engineering team from being able to link projects to the billing account. Only the finance team should be permitted to link a project to a billing account, and the finance team should not be able to make any other changes to projects.  
  
What should you do?

options.A: Assign the finance team only the Billing Account User role on the billing account.
options.B: Assign the engineering team only the Billing Account User role on the billing account.
options.C: Assign the finance team the Billing Account User role on the billing account and the Project Billing Manager role on the organization.
options.D: Assign the engineering team the Billing Account User role on the billing account and the Project Billing Manager role on the organization.

questions.question: You are the Organization Administrator for your company's Google Cloud resources. Your company has strict compliance rules that require you to be notified about any modifications to files and documents hosted on Cloud Storage. In a recent incident, one of your team members was able to modify files and you did not receive any notifications, causing other production jobs to fail. You must ensure that you receive notifications for all changes to files and documents in Cloud Storage while minimizing management overhead. What should you do?

options.A: View Cloud Audit logs for all Cloud Storage files in Logs Explorer. Filter by Admin Activity logs.
options.B: Enable Cloud Storage object versioning on your bucket. Configure Pub/Sub notifications for your Cloud Storage buckets.
options.C: Enable versioning on the Cloud Storage bucket. Set up a custom script that scans versions of Cloud Storage objects being modified and alert the admin by using the script.
options.D: Configure Pub/Sub notifications on the Cloud Storage buckets to publish object change events to a Pub/Sub topic.

questions.question: You need to design an archiving solution for data stored in a Cloud Storage bucket, and it must be cost-effective. Objects that have multiple versions should have their older versions archived after 30 days. These previous versions are accessed about once a month for reporting purposes, and the archived data is also occasionally updated at the end of each month. What should you do?

options.A: Add a bucket lifecycle rule that archives data with newer versions after 30 days to Coldline Storage.
options.B: Add a bucket lifecycle rule that archives data with newer versions after 30 days to Nearline Storage.
options.C: Add a bucket lifecycle rule that archives data from regional storage after 30 days to Coldline Storage.
options.D: Add a bucket lifecycle rule that archives data from regional storage after 30 days to Nearline Storage.

questions.question:
You are running an application across multiple virtual machine instances within a managed instance group, with autoscaling enabled. The autoscaling policy adds instances to the group when CPU utilization exceeds 80%, continuing to add VMs until either the group reaches its maximum size of five VMs or CPU utilization drops back to 80%. The HTTP health check configured for the instances has an initial delay of 30 seconds.  
  
You notice that the VM instances take approximately three minutes to become available to end users. When the instance group autoscales, it ends up provisioning more instances than are actually required to handle the current level of end-user traffic.  
  
You want to ensure that the instance group size is properly maintained during autoscaling. What should you do?

options.A: Set the maximum number of instances to 1.
options.B: Decrease the maximum number of instances to 3.
options.C: Use a TCP health check instead of an HTTP health check.
options.D: Increase the initial delay of the HTTP health check to 200 seconds.

questions.question: You are working with a user to set up an application in a new VPC that sits behind a firewall. The user is concerned about data egress, and you want to configure the fewest open egress ports possible. What should you do?

options.A: Set up a low-priority (65534) rule that blocks all egress and a high-priority rule (1000) that allows only the appropriate ports.
options.B: Set up a high-priority (1000) rule that pairs both ingress and egress ports.
options.C: Set up a high-priority (1000) rule that blocks all egress and a low-priority (65534) rule that allows only the appropriate ports.
options.D: Set up a high-priority (1000) rule to allow the appropriate ports.

questions.question:
You are working with a Cloud SQL for MySQL database at your company. You need to retain a month-end copy of the database for three years for audit purposes.  
  
What should you do?

options.A: Set up an export job for the first of the month. Write the export file to an Archive class Cloud Storage bucket.
options.B: Save the automatic first-of-the-month backup for three years. Store the backup file in an Archive class Cloud Storage bucket.
options.C: Set up an on-demand backup for the first of the month. Write the backup to an Archive class Cloud Storage bucket.
options.D: Convert the automatic first-of-the-month backup to an export file. Write the export file to a Coldline class Cloud Storage bucket.

questions.question:
Your organization follows a hybrid cloud strategy, with some applications running on Google Cloud. A VPN tunnel links your VPC in Google Cloud to your company's on-premises network. Several applications hosted in Google Cloud must connect to an on-premises database server, and you want to avoid having to update the IP configuration across all of your applications whenever the database's IP address changes.  
  
What should you do?

options.A: Configure Cloud NAT for all subnets of your VPC to be used when egressing from the VM instances.
options.B: Create a private zone on Cloud DNS, and configure the applications with the DNS name.
options.C: Configure the IP of the database as custom metadata for each instance, and query the metadata server.
options.D: Query the Compute Engine internal DNS from the applications to retrieve the IP of the database.

questions.question: You run an application that accepts SSL-encrypted TCP traffic on port 443. Its clients are distributed worldwide, and you want to minimize the latency they experience. Which load balancing option should you choose?

options.A: Global external Application Load Balancer (HTTPS)
options.B: External passthrough Network Load Balancer
options.C: Global external proxy Network Load Balancer with an SSL proxy
options.D: Internal passthrough Network Load Balancer. Add a firewall rule allowing ingress traffic from 0.0.0.0/0 on the target instances.

questions.question: You have virtual machines running in a subnet whose subnet mask is 255.255.255.240. This subnet currently has no available IP addresses left, and you need 10 more IP addresses for new VMs. Both the existing VMs and the new VMs must be able to communicate with each other without requiring any additional routes. What should you do?

options.A: Use gcloud to expand the IP range of the current subnet.
options.B: Delete the subnet, and recreate it using a wider range of IP addresses.
options.C: Create a new project. Use Shared VPC to share the current network with the new project.
options.D: Create a new subnet with the same starting IP but a wider range to overwrite the current subnet.

questions.question: Management has selected Google Cloud as the company’s strategic cloud provider. You must provision Google Cloud identities for every employee in the IT and Data departments, but not for employees in other departments. This access must update automatically when employees move departments, join, or leave the company. All employees are centrally managed in an LDAP directory, with one organizational unit (OU) per department. What should you do?

options.A: Develop a containerized application that reads user information from the relevant OUs in the LDAP directory. Use the Directory API to create accounts in Cloud Identity for new users. Deploy the application as a scheduled Cloud Run job.
options.B: Develop a containerized application that reads user information from the relevant OUs in the LDAP directory. Use the Admin SDK to synchronize user accounts in Identity Platform with the LDAP directory. Deploy the application as a scheduled Cloud Run job.
options.C: Create a CSV file with the users from the relevant OUs. Upload the CSV file to Cloud Identity. Instruct your Human Resources department to repeat this process for any employee changes.
options.D: Configure Google Cloud Directory Sync to synchronize the relevant OUs between the LDAP directory and Cloud Identity. Set up a scheduled task that triggers a provisioning run.

questions.question:
You are planning to migrate the following on-premises data management solutions to Google Cloud:  
  
• One MySQL cluster for your main database  

• Apache Kafka for your event streaming platform  

• One PostgreSQL database for your analytical and reporting needs  
  
You want to implement Google-recommended solutions for the migration. You need to ensure that the new solutions provide global scalability and require minimal operational and infrastructure management. What should you do?

options.B: Migrate from MySQL to Spanner, from Kafka to Pub/Sub, and from PostgreSQL to BigQuery.

options.D: Migrate from MySQL to Cloud SQL, from Kafka to Memorystore, and from PostgreSQL to Cloud SQL.

questions.question: Your company's security vulnerability management policy wants a member of the security team to have visibility into vulnerabilities and other OS metadata for a specific Compute Engine instance. This Compute Engine instance hosts a critical application in your Google Cloud project. You need to implement your company's security vulnerability management policy. What should you do?

options.A: 1. Ensure that the Ops Agent is installed on the Compute Engine instance. 2. Create a custom metric in the Cloud Monitoring dashboard. 3. Provide the security team member with access to this dashboard.
options.B: 1. Ensure that the Ops Agent is installed on the Compute Engine instance. 2. Provide the security team member the roles/osconfig.inventoryViewer role.
options.C: 1. Ensure that the OS Config agent is installed on the Compute Engine instance. 2. Provide the security team member the roles/osconfig.vulnerabilityReportViewer role.
options.D: 1. Ensure that the OS Config agent is installed on the Compute Engine instance. 2. Create a log sink to BigQuery dataset. 3. Provide the security team member with access to this dataset.

questions.question: You are running a web application on Cloud Run for a few hundred users. Some of your users complain that the initial web page of the application takes much longer to load than the following pages. You want to follow Google’s recommendations to mitigate the issue. What should you do?

options.A: Set the minimum number of instances for your Cloud Run service to 3.
options.B: Set the concurrency number to 1 for your Cloud Run service.
options.C: Set the maximum number of instances for your Cloud Run service to 100.
options.D: Update your web application to use the protocol HTTP/2 instead of HTTP/1.1.

questions.question: You deployed an application on a managed instance group in Compute Engine. The application accepts Transmission Control Protocol (TCP) traffic on port 389 and requires you to preserve the IP address of the client who is making a request. You want to expose the application to the internet by using a load balancer. What should you do?

options.A: Expose the application by using an external passthrough Network Load Balancer.
options.B: Expose the application by using an external proxy Network Load Balancer (TCP proxy).
options.C: Expose the application by using an external proxy Network Load Balancer (SSL proxy).
options.D: Expose the application by using an internal passthrough Network Load Balancer.

questions.question: You are planning to deploy an application to Google Cloud. Your application processes asynchronous events from Google services and must be accessible from the public Internet. You need to identify how to deploy your application. You want to follow a standardized process while minimizing development costs. You also want to have no costs when your workloads are not in use. What should you do?

options.A: Deploy your code to GKE. Use Pub/Sub for event delivery.
options.B: Deploy your code to Compute Engine. Use Pub/Sub for event delivery.
options.C: Deploy your code to GKE. Use Eventarc for event delivery.
options.D: Deploy your code to Cloud Run. Use Eventarc for event delivery.

questions.question: You are deploying an application to a Compute Engine VM that belongs to a managed instance group. The application must always be running, but only one instance of the VM should run per Google Cloud project. How should you configure the instance group?

options.A: Set autoscaling to On, set the minimum number of instances to 1, and then set the maximum number of instances to 1.
options.B: Set autoscaling to Off, set the minimum number of instances to 1, and then set the maximum number of instances to 1.
options.C: Set autoscaling to On, set the minimum number of instances to 1, and then set the maximum number of instances to 2.
options.D: Set autoscaling to Off, set the minimum number of instances to 1, and then set the maximum number of instances to 2.

questions.question: Your digital media company stores a large number of video files on-premises. Each video file ranges from 100 MB to 100 GB. You are currently storing 150 TB of video data in your on-premises network, with no room for expansion. You need to migrate all infrequently accessed video files older than one year to Cloud Storage to ensure that on-premises storage remains available for new files. You must also minimize costs and control bandwidth usage. What should you do?

options.A: Use Storage Transfer Service to move the data from the selected on-premises file storage systems to a Cloud Storage bucket.
options.B: Use Transfer Appliance to request an appliance. Load the data locally, and ship the appliance back to Google for ingestion into Cloud Storage.
options.C: Set up a Cloud Interconnect connection between the on-premises network and Google Cloud. Establish a private endpoint for Filestore access. Transfer the data from the existing Network File System (NFS) to Filestore.
options.D: Create a Cloud Storage bucket. Establish an Identity and Access Management (IAM) role with write permissions to the bucket. Use the gcloud storage cp command to directly copy files over the network to Cloud Storage.

questions.question: You manage Google Cloud infrastructure using Terraform, and the Terraform configuration files are kept in a Git repository. You need to implement a solution that lets multiple team members work on the Terraform configurations concurrently without conflicts, while ensuring sensitive values are not stored on local machines. What should you do?

options.A: Configure a local backend in Terraform, and deploy all changes by using a shared account on a bastion server.
options.B: Configure a Cloud Storage backend in Terraform.
options.C: Configure a local backend in Terraform, and store the state file in a Git repository.
options.D: Configure a local backend in Terraform, and manually share the Terraform state file with team members after every change.

questions.question:
You have a single binary application that you want to run on Google Cloud. You have decided to automatically scale the application based on the underlying infrastructure's CPU usage. Your organization's policies require you to use virtual machines directly.  
  
You need to ensure that the application scaling is operationally efficient and completed as quickly as possible. What should you do?

options.A: Create a Google Kubernetes Engine cluster, and use horizontal pod autoscaling to scale the application.
options.B: Create an instance template, and use the template in a managed instance group with autoscaling configured.
options.C: Create an instance template, and use the template in a managed instance group that scales up and down based on the time of day.
options.D: Use a set of third-party tools to build automation around scaling the application up and down, based on Cloud Monitoring CPU usage metrics.

questions.question: You have a website hosted on the App Engine standard environment. You want 1% of your users to see a new test version of the website, and you want to minimize complexity. What should you do?

options.A: Deploy the new version in the same application and use the --migrate option.
options.B: Deploy the new version in the same application and use the --splits option to give a weight of 99 to the current version and a weight of 1 to the new version.
options.C: Create a new App Engine application in the same project. Deploy the new version in that application. Use the App Engine library to proxy 1% of the requests to the new version.
options.D: Create a new App Engine application in the same project. Deploy the new version in that application. Configure your network load balancer to send 1% of the traffic to that new application.

questions.question: Your company is running a three-tier web application on virtual machines that use a MySQL database. You need to create an estimated total cost of cloud infrastructure to run this application on Google Cloud instances and Cloud SQL. What should you do?

options.A: Create a Google spreadsheet with multiple Google Cloud resource combinations. On a separate sheet, import the current Google Cloud prices and use these prices for the calculations within formulas.
options.B: Use the Google Cloud Pricing Calculator and select the Cloud Operations template to define your web application with as much detail as possible.
options.C: Implement a similar architecture on Google Cloud, and run a reasonable load test on a smaller scale. Check the billing information, and calculate the estimated costs based on the real load your system usually handles.
options.D: Use the Google Cloud Pricing Calculator to determine the cost of every Google Cloud resource you expect to use. Use similar size instances for the web server, and use your current on-premises machines as a comparison for Cloud SQL.

questions.question:
You need to configure 10 Compute Engine instances so they remain available during maintenance events. The requirements specify that:  
  
- The instances should attempt to automatically restart if they crash.  
- The instances should be highly available, including during system maintenance.  
  
What should you do?

options.A: Create an instance template for the instances. Set the 'Automatic Restart' to on. Set the 'On-host maintenance' to Migrate VM instance. Add the instance template to an instance group.
options.B: Create an instance template for the instances. Set 'Automatic Restart' to off. Set 'On-host maintenance' to Terminate VM instances. Add the instance template to an instance group.
options.C: Create an instance group for the instances. Set the 'Autohealing' health check to healthy (HTTP).
options.D: Create an instance group for the instance. Verify that the 'Advanced creation options' setting for 'do not retry machine creation' is set to off.

questions.question: You have an application that is currently processing transactions by using a group of managed VM instances. You need to migrate the application so that it is serverless and scalable. You want to implement an asynchronous transaction processing system, while minimizing management overhead. What should you do?

options.A: Install Kafka on VM instances to acknowledge incoming transactions. Use Cloud Run to process transactions.
options.B: Use Pub/Sub to acknowledge incoming transactions. Use VM instances to process transactions.
options.C: Use Pub/Sub to acknowledge incoming transactions. Use Cloud Run to process transactions.
options.D: Install Kafka on VM instances to acknowledge incoming transactions. Use VM instances to process transactions.

questions.question: You have a Bigtable instance that consists of three nodes that store personally identifiable information (PII) data. You need to log all read or write operations, including any metadata or configuration reads of this database table, in your company’s Security Information and Event Management (SIEM) system. What should you do?

options.A: • Navigate to Cloud Monitoring in the Google Cloud console, and create a custom monitoring job for the Bigtable instance to track all changes. • Create an alert by using webhook endpoints, with the SIEM endpoint as a receiver.
options.B: • Navigate to the Audit Logs page in the Google Cloud console, and enable Admin Write logs for the Bigtable instance. • Create a Cloud Run function to export logs from Cloud Logging to your SIEM.
options.C: • Navigate to the Audit Logs page in the Google Cloud console, and enable Data Read, Data Write and Admin Read logs for the Bigtable instance. • Create a Pub/Sub topic as a Cloud Logging sink destination, and add your SIEM as a subscriber to the topic.
options.D: • Install the Ops Agent on the Bigtable instance during configuration. • Create a service account with read permissions for the Bigtable instance. • Create a custom Dataflow job with this service account to export logs to the company’s SIEM system.

questions.question: Your company is modernizing its applications and refactoring them to containerized microservices. You need to deploy the infrastructure on Google Cloud so that teams can deploy their applications. The applications cannot be exposed publicly. You want to minimize management and operational overhead. What should you do?

options.A: Provision a Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Autopilot cluster.
options.B: Provision a fleet of Compute Engine instances and install Kubernetes.
options.C: Provision a Standard regional Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) cluster.
options.D: Provision a Standard zonal Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) cluster.

questions.question: You are in charge of provisioning access for all Google Cloud users in your organization. Your company recently acquired a startup company that has their own Google Cloud organization. You need to ensure that your Site Reliability Engineers (SREs) have the same project permissions in the startup company's organization as in your own organization. What should you do?

options.A: In the Google Cloud console for your organization, select Create role from selection, and choose destination as the startup company's organization.
options.B: In the Google Cloud console for the startup company, select Create role from selection and choose source as the startup company's Google Cloud organization.
options.C: Use the gcloud iam roles copy command, and provide the Organization ID of the startup company's Google Cloud Organization as the destination.
options.D: Use the gcloud iam roles copy command, and provide the project IDs of all projects in the startup company's organization as the destination.

questions.question: Every employee in your company has a Google account. Your operations team must manage a large number of Compute Engine instances, and each team member only needs administrative access to these servers. Your security team wants the credential deployment process to be operationally efficient, while also being able to determine who accessed any given instance. What should you do?

options.A: Generate a new SSH key pair. Give the private key to each member of your team. Configure the public key in the metadata of each instance.
options.B: Ask each member of the team to generate a new SSH key pair and to send you their public key. Use a configuration management tool to deploy those keys on each instance.
options.C: Ask each member of the team to generate a new SSH key pair and to add the public key to their Google account. Grant the roles/compute.osAdminLogin role to the Google group corresponding to this team.
options.D: Generate a new SSH key pair. Give the private key to each member of your team. Configure the public key as a project-wide public SSH key in your Google Cloud project and allow project-wide public SSH keys on each instance.

questions.question: You are performing a monthly security check of your Google Cloud environment and want to know who has access to view data stored in your Google Cloud project. What should you do?

options.A: Enable Audit Logs for all APIs that are related to data storage.
options.B: Review the IAM permissions for any role that allows for data access.
options.C: Review the Identity-Aware Proxy settings for each resource.
options.D: Create a Sensitive Data Protection (DLP) inspection job.

questions.question: Your company uses a multi-cloud strategy that includes Google Cloud. You want to centralize application logs in a third-party software-as-a-service (SaaS) tool from all environments. You need to integrate logs originating from Cloud Logging, and you want to ensure the export occurs with the least amount of delay possible. What should you do?

options.A: Create a Cloud Logging sink and configure BigQuery as the destination. Configure the SaaS tool to query BigQuery to retrieve the logs.
options.B: Create a Cloud Logging sink and configure Pub/Sub as the destination. Configure the SaaS tool to subscribe to the Pub/Sub topic to retrieve the logs.
options.C: Create a Cloud Logging sink and configure Cloud Storage as the destination. Configure the SaaS tool to read the Cloud Storage bucket to retrieve the logs.
options.D: Use a Cloud Scheduler cron job to trigger a Cloud Run function that queries Cloud Logging and sends the logs to the SaaS tool.

questions.question: Your team wants to deploy a specific content management system (CMS) solution to Google Cloud. You need a quick and easy way to deploy and install the solution. What should you do?

options.A: Search for the CMS solution in Google Cloud Marketplace. Use gcloud CLI to deploy the solution.
options.B: Search for the CMS solution in Google Cloud Marketplace. Deploy the solution directly from Cloud Marketplace.
options.C: Search for the CMS solution in Google Cloud Marketplace. Use Terraform and the Cloud Marketplace ID to deploy the solution with the appropriate parameters.
options.D: Use the installation guide of the CMS provider. Perform the installation through your configuration management system.

questions.question: You need to migrate multiple PostgreSQL databases from your on-premises data center to Google Cloud. You want to significantly improve the performance of your databases while minimizing changes to your data schema and application code. You expect your largest database to exceed 150 TB of data per geographical region. You want to follow Google-recommended practices and minimize your operational costs. What should you do?

options.A: Migrate your data to AlloyDB.
options.B: Migrate your data to Spanner.
options.C: Migrate your data to Firestore.
options.D: Migrate your data to Bigtable.

questions.question: You are managing a project for the Business Intelligence (BI) department in your company. A data pipeline streams data into BigQuery. You want members of the BI department to be able to run custom SQL queries against the latest data in BigQuery. What should you do?

options.A: Create a Data Studio dashboard that uses the related BigQuery tables as a source and give the BI team view access to the Data Studio dashboard.
options.B: Create a Service Account for the BI team and distribute a new private key to each member of the BI team.
options.C: Use Cloud Scheduler to schedule a batch Dataflow job to copy the data from BigQuery to the BI team's internal data warehouse.
options.D: Assign the IAM role of BigQuery User to a Google Group that contains the members of the BI team.

questions.question: Your organization has adopted BigQuery as its enterprise data warehouse, and users across several business units run queries against it. You have observed that BigQuery query costs are very high, and you need to bring these costs under control. Which two methods should you use? (Choose two.)

options.A: Split the users from business units to multiple projects.
options.B: Apply a user- or project-level custom query quota for BigQuery data warehouse.
options.C: Create separate copies of your BigQuery data warehouse for each business unit.
options.D: Split your BigQuery data warehouse into multiple data warehouses for each business unit.
options.E: Switch from on-demand pricing to capacity-based pricing with BigQuery editions. Create slot reservations and assign the appropriate number of slots to each project.

questions.question: Your organization already has three Google Cloud projects. You must charge the Marketing department only for its Google Cloud services used by a new initiative within that group. What should you do?

options.A: 1. Verify that you are assigned the Billing Account Administrator IAM role (roles/billing.admin) for your organization's Google Cloud Project for the Marketing department. 2. Link the new project to a Marketing Billing Account.
options.B: 1. Verify that you are assigned the Billing Account Administrator IAM role (roles/billing.admin) for your organization's Google Cloud account. 2. Create a new Google Cloud Project for the Marketing department. 3. Set the default key-value project labels to department:marketing for all services in this project.
options.C: 1. Verify that you are assigned the Organization Administrator IAM role for your organization's Google Cloud account. 2. Create a new Google Cloud Project for the Marketing department. 3. Link the new project to a Marketing Billing Account.
options.D: 1. Verify that you are assigned the Organization Administrator IAM role for your organization's Google Cloud account. 2. Create a new Google Cloud Project for the Marketing department. 3. Set the default key-value project labels to department:marketing for all services in this project.

questions.question: You manage all your service accounts in a single project named proj-sa. You want to use a service account from this project to take snapshots of VMs that run in a different project, called proj-vm. What should you do?

options.A: Download the private key from the service account, and add it to each VM's custom metadata.
options.B: Download the private key from the service account, and add the private key to each VM's SSH keys.
options.C: Grant the service account the IAM Role of Compute Storage Admin in the project called proj-vm.
options.D: When creating the VMs, set the service account's API scope for Compute Engine to read/write.

questions.question: You are responsible for a web application on Compute Engine. You want your support team to be notified automatically if users experience high latency for at least 5 minutes. You need a Google-recommended solution with no development cost. What should you do?

options.A: Export Cloud Monitoring metrics to BigQuery and use a Data Studio dashboard to monitor your web application’s latency.
options.B: Create an alert policy to send a notification when the HTTP response latency exceeds the specified threshold.
options.C: Implement an App Engine service which invokes the Cloud Monitoring API and sends a notification in case of anomalies.
options.D: Use the Cloud Monitoring dashboard to observe latency and take the necessary actions when the response latency exceeds the specified threshold.

questions.question: You need to send all logs from all of your Compute Engine instances to a BigQuery dataset named platform-logs for analysis purposes. The Ops Agent has already been installed on all the instances. You want to minimize cost. What should you do?

options.A: 1. Give the BigQuery Data Editor role on the platform-logs dataset to the service accounts used by your instances. 2. Update your instances' metadata to add the following value: logs-destination: bq://platform-logs.
options.B: 1. In Cloud Logging, create a logs export with a Pub/Sub topic called logs as a sink. 2. Create a Cloud Run function that is triggered by messages in the logs topic. 3. Configure that Cloud Run function to drop logs that are not from Compute Engine and to insert Compute Engine logs in the platform-logs dataset.
options.C: 1. In Cloud Logging, create a filter to view only Compute Engine logs. 2. Click Create sink. 3. Choose BigQuery as Sink Service, and the platform-logs dataset as Sink Destination.
options.D: 1. Create a Cloud Run function that has the BigQuery User role on the platform-logs dataset. 2. Configure this Cloud Run function to create a BigQuery Job that executes this query: INSERT INTO dataset.platform-logs (timestamp, log) SELECT timestamp, log FROM compute.logs WHERE timestamp > DATE_SUB(CURRENT_DATE(), INTERVAL 1 DAY) 3. Use Cloud Scheduler to trigger this Cloud Run function once a day.

questions.question: You are responsible for Google Cloud governance at your company and recently introduced a new automated process for provisioning Google Cloud projects. You have found several projects that were created manually before this new process was implemented. You need to identify the creators of these projects so you can notify them about the new process. What should you do?

options.A: Review the value of the creator label attached to the project to find the project’s creator.
options.B: Use Resource Manager to identify the responsible department from the folder and project hierarchy.
options.C: Review the Cloud Billing account linked to the project, and then contact the owner of that billing account.
options.D: Use the IAM page in the Google Cloud console to identify the user with the Owner role.

questions.question: You are planning to migrate your containerized workloads to Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE). You need to determine which GKE option to use. Your solution must have high availability, minimal downtime, and the ability to promptly apply security updates to your nodes. You also want to pay only for the compute resources that your workloads use without managing nodes. You want to follow Google-recommended practices and minimize operational costs. options.C: Configure a Standard multi-zonal GKE cluster.

questions.question: Your company’s accounting department needs to run an overnight batch workload every day. You must implement a solution that minimizes the cost to run this workload and automatically retries the batch if an execution fails. What should you do?

options.A: Develop an application that runs the batch workload, and deploy the application as a Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) CronJob.
options.B: Develop a web application that listens for incoming requests, and deploy the application as a Cloud Run service. Use Cloud Scheduler to call the HTTP endpoint.
options.C: Develop an application that runs the batch workload, and deploy the application as a Cloud Run job. Use Cloud Scheduler to trigger the job.
options.D: Develop a web application that listens for incoming requests, and deploy the application as a Google Kubernetes Engine (GKE) Deployment. Use Cloud Scheduler to call the HTTP endpoint.

questions.question: You have a large 5-TB AVRO file stored in a Cloud Storage bucket. Your analysts know only SQL and need to access the data in this file. You want the most cost-effective way to fulfill their request as quickly as possible. What should you do?

options.A: Load data in Firestore in Datastore mode and run a SQL query against it.
options.B: Create a BigQuery table and load data in BigQuery. Run a SQL query on this table and drop this table after you complete your request.
options.C: Create external tables in BigQuery that point to Cloud Storage buckets and run a SQL query on these external tables to complete your request.
options.D: Create a Hadoop cluster and copy the AVRO file to HDFS by compressing it. Load the file in a Hive table and provide access to your analysts so that they can run SQL queries.

questions.question: Your company has a rapidly growing social media platform and a user base primarily located in North America. Due to increasing demand, your current on-premises PostgreSQL database, hosted in your United States headquarters data center, no longer meets your needs. You need to identify a cloud-based database solution that offers automatic scaling, multi-region support for future expansion, and maintains low latency. What should you do?

options.A: Use BigQuery.
options.B: Use Spanner.
options.C: Use Cloud SQL for PostgreSQL.
options.D: Use Bigtable.

questions.question: You want to permanently delete a Pub/Sub topic managed by Config Connector in your Google Cloud project. What should you do?

options.A: Use kubectl to create the label deleted-by-cnrm and to change its value to true for the topic resource.
options.B: Use kubectl to delete the topic resource.
options.C: Use gcloud CLI to delete the topic.
options.D: Use gcloud CLI to update the topic label managed-by-cnrm to false.

questions.question:
Your company runs a 3-tier solution on Compute Engine. The current infrastructure configuration is shown in the accompanying diagram.  
  
![Question Image](https://cdn.examcademy.com/images/questions/1783719377390-2yoo4gwx.png)  
  
Each tier has its own service account, and that service account is associated with every instance in that tier. You need to enable communication over TCP port 8080 between the tiers according to the following requirements:  
  
- Instances in tier #1 must be able to communicate with instances in tier #2.

What should you do?

options.A: 1. Create an ingress firewall rule with the following settings: Targets: all instances; Source filter: IP ranges (with the range set to 10.0.2.0/24); Protocols: allow all. 2. Create an ingress firewall rule with the following settings: Targets: all instances; Source filter: IP ranges (with the range set to 10.0.1.0/24); Protocols: allow all
options.B: 1. Create an ingress firewall rule with the following settings: Targets: all instances with tier #2 service account; Source filter: all instances with tier #1 service account; Protocols: allow TCP:8080. 2. Create an ingress firewall rule with the following settings: Targets: all instances with tier #3 service account; Source filter: all instances with tier #2 service account; Protocols: allow TCP:8080
options.C: 1. options.D: 1. Create an egress firewall rule with the following settings: Targets: all instances; Source filter: IP ranges (with the range set to 10.0.2.0/24); Protocols: allow TCP:8080. 2. Create an egress firewall rule with the following settings: Targets: all instances; Source filter: IP ranges (with the range set to 10.0.1.0/24); Protocols: allow TCP:8080

questions.question: Your company requires that Google Cloud products are created with a specific configuration to comply with your company’s security policies. You need to implement a mechanism that will allow software engineers at your company to deploy and update Google Cloud products in a preconfigured and approved manner. What should you do?

options.A: Create Java packages that utilize the Google Cloud Client Libraries for Java to configure Google Cloud products. Store and share the packages in a source code repository.
options.B: Create bash scripts that utilize the Google Cloud CLI to configure Google Cloud products. Store and share the bash scripts in a source code repository.
options.C: Use the Google Cloud APIs by using curl to configure Google Cloud products. Store and share the curl commands in a source code repository.
options.D: Create Terraform modules that utilize the Google Cloud Terraform Provider to configure Google Cloud products. Store and share the modules in a source code repository.

questions.question: You have successfully set up a development environment within a project for an application that relies on Compute Engine and Cloud SQL. You now need to build out a production environment for this same application. The security team has mandated that no network routes may exist between these two environments, and they want you to follow Google-recommended practices. What should you do?

options.A: Create a new project, enable the Compute Engine and Cloud SQL APIs in that project, and replicate the setup you have created in the development environment.
options.B: Create a new production subnet in the existing VPC and a new production Cloud SQL instance in your existing project, and deploy your application using those resources.
options.C: Create a new project, modify your existing VPC to be a Shared VPC, share that VPC with your new project, and replicate the setup you have in the development environment in that new project in the Shared VPC.
options.D: Ask the security team to grant you the Project Editor role in an existing production project used by another division of your company. Once they grant you that role, replicate the setup you have in the development environment in that project.

questions.question: You are monitoring an application and receive user feedback that a particular error is spiking. You determine that the error is caused by a Service Account having insufficient permissions. You are able to resolve the issue, but you also want to be notified automatically if the same problem happens again. What should you do?

options.A: In the Logs Explorer, filter the logs on severity 'Error' and the name of the Service Account.
options.B: Create a sink to BigQuery to export all the logs. Create a Data Studio dashboard on the exported logs.
options.C: Create a custom log-based metric for the specific error to be used in an Alerting Policy.
options.D: Grant Project Owner access to the Service Account.

questions.question:
You need to configure Object Lifecycle Management for objects stored in storage buckets. The objects are written once and then accessed frequently for the first 30 days. After that 30-day period, the objects are not read again unless there is a special need. The objects must be retained for a total of three years, and you want to minimize cost.  
  
What should you do?

options.A: Set up a policy that uses Nearline storage for 30 days and then moves to Archive storage for three years.
